metaTitle: About TropiNord | Oils, Teas, Coffee, and Superfoods from the Tropics, with Nordic Standards
metaDescription: Discover TropiNord — Nordic precision meets tropical innovation. We are a digitally-driven platform creating traceable, sustainable oils, teas, coffee, and superfoods from Africa, supporting small producers and funding climate action. Founded in Sweden by a student entrepreneur.
heading: Connecting Nature, Innovation, and Wellbeing
subheading: Where tradition meets technology for natural wellbeing.

ourStoryContent.p1: At TropiNord, we believe wellness should connect people to nature, to heritage, and to the wisdom that sustains both.
ourStoryContent.p2: Born in Sweden, TropiNord blends Nordic precision with tropical innovation to create natural products that nurture, restore, and protect.
ourStoryContent.p3: Built from the ground up by an IT student and entrepreneur, TropiNord is more than a wellness brand. It is a digitally driven sustainability platform. Our systems, logistics, and digital architecture were designed in-house to make global trade between small producers and modern consumers transparent, traceable, and fair.
ourStoryContent.list1: Sustainable value chains through digital traceability and transparent sourcing
ourStoryContent.list2: Eco-innovation using biodegradable and circular packaging concepts
ourStoryContent.list3: Inclusive growth and fair opportunities for smallholder producers
ourStoryContent.p4: We believe technology can bring clarity, fairness, and connection to the global wellness industry.
ourStoryContent.quote: We collaborate with smallholder producers across Africa, and tropical regions to develop sustainably sourced teas, oils, coffee, and superfoods. Every ingredient tells a story of craft, culture, and care, refined through science, design, and technology.

valuesContent: TropiNord is a sustainability and innovation hub. We bridge continents through collaboration, empower local producers, and design transparent, circular systems that link traditional wisdom with modern tools.
whatWeDoItem1: Develop and distribute functional teas, natural oils, coffee, and superfoods of traceable and sustainable origin
whatWeDoItem2: Partner with ethical producers and eco-innovators across Africa, other tropical regions, and Europe
whatWeDoItem3: Pilot digital traceability models for transparent supply chains
whatWeDoItem4: Offer a platform where small businesses can grow sustainably and reach new markets
whatWeDoExtra: Every product we share is chosen with purpose for its purity, its story, and its ability to make a measurable impact.
ourMissionContent: To redefine natural wellness through innovation, technology, and care, linking tradition with modern tools to create products that are as responsible as they are restorative.
ourMissionTagline: TropiNord: Where tradition meets technology for natural wellbeing.
